title: Paulus van de Perre (London) to Johan de Bruyne, Aug-Nov 1653: the cipher runs printed in Thurloe I (Birch 1742)

documents.shelfmark: Birch, Thurloe State Papers i (1742) pp. 431, 500, 522-523, 576, 582 (originals Bodleian Rawlinson A)
documents.route: Paulus van de Perre (London) -> Johan de Bruyne (Zeeland)

plaintext.source: Thurloe's office's English glosses of 1653, printed over parts of the runs by Birch (1742)

transcription.source: The contributor of issue #556 from the Internet Archive scan collectionofstat01thur; 98 groups on p. 500 re-checked here against the scan
transcription.notes: 20 runs, five letters; a printed book, not the manuscript.

system.summary: A 22-letter alphabetical substitution in figures (about a = 3 to w = 29) with signs for ij and ee and a few word codes.
system.notes: Key from the contributor's key.json; codes 109 Harrison, 76 Denmark, 52 queen of Sweden, 115 Jarmuyen, 617 de.

prior_solution.where: Birch (1742), Thurloe i: the 1653 English glosses of Thurloe's translators over the runs

conditions.human_role: Contributed result (GitHub issue #556, aaymeloglu): the contributor transcribed the runs, rebuilt the key from the digits (by the contributor's record, before using the glosses) and used the glosses for five code meanings; the project only checked and filed it. The contributor names Claude Code as the tool.
tools: bijective simulated annealing over a Dutch 4-gram model (contributor's solve.py, not run here)

solution.what: By the contributor (by the contributor's record): bijective annealing over a 4-gram model of Hooft's Nederlandsche Historien on the digits; four of eight restarts converged; remaining values by hand; glosses checked afterwards (five code meanings); key-shuffle z = 18.0.
Integration check: own_decode.py reproduces all 20 runs; 98 groups of p. 500 (IA leaf n529) agree with the transcription; the key gives gibberish on targets/thurloe piece (a).
Strict count over the contributor's reading table (reading.md): about 44 of 61 words = 72% (repaired words and unresolved strings as holes); contributor's grades 304 S, 5 C, 13 I of 322 groups.

outcome.method_basis: By the contributor (issue #556): the alphabet was annealed from the printed digits; the printed 1653 glosses were used afterwards for five code meanings (order by the contributor's record).
outcome.fraction_read_source: reading.md (contributor's reading table): about 44 of 61 words read under the strict rule, counted 14 Nov 2026

gaps.detail: printer's or writer's slips; only the Bodleian Rawlinson A originals can settle them

gaps.item: Bodleian MS. Rawl. A.7 old p. 47 (17 Oct 1653)
gaps.detail: partly in cipher, not in Birch, not seen

texts.summary: Van de Perre reports to the pensionary of Zeeland a reasonable disposition in London to negotiate peace, the waning influence of Harrison and the Anabaptists, Colonel Wurts posing as Denmark's envoy while pensioned by the queen of Sweden, and desertion and want of masts in the English fleet.
